entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie, I need to start a return for a VeloBand GPS Tracker I recently purchased.
I can certainly look into that for you. To confirm, is this the new VeloBand Pulse model?
Yes, that's the one. The Pulse. I got it about 11 days ago and it's just not what I was looking for.
Okay, I understand. Just to be thorough, can I ask what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a personal preference?
It's just a preference thing. The features aren't a great match for my routine. I'd like to process a refund.

I see. I do need to let you know that due to the device activation and hygiene protocols, the VeloBand Pulse has a strict 10-day return window. Since you received it 11 days ago, it looks like it's just outside of that policy.

Right, I understand what the system says today. But I actually tried to do this two days ago, on the 9th day. Your website was down for maintenance or something. I got a website error page every time I tried to access the returns portal.
You're saying you attempted the return on day nine but were unable to? Can you tell me more about what happened?

Exactly. The whole returns system seemed to be down. I couldn't get the page to load, so I couldn't print the label or even get a return number. It was very frustrating. I even took a screenshot of the error message.
Thank you for that information, let me check our system status logs for that day. One moment please.
Okay, I've checked the logs. It looks like we did have a reported system down event that impacted the customer portal for several hours two days ago. I see the notes about the website error here.
So, you can see it was your system that prevented me from meeting the 10-day deadline. We should be able to make an exception, right?

Yes, absolutely. Since the fault was on our end and you made the attempt within the valid window, I am happy to approve a full refund exception for you. I sincerely apologize for the trouble the site outage caused.
That's great, I appreciate you looking into that. Since I had to go to the trouble of calling in because of the system issue, would it be possible to get a small discount code for a future purchase?

I understand the request, but our policy in this case is to make it right by ensuring you get the full refund you're entitled to. I can't add a discount code on top of the policy exception, but I can assure you I will process this return for you immediately. I'm emailing you the return label now. You should have it in the next five minutes.
Okay, that's fair. A full refund is the main thing. Thank you for resolving this, Charlie.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Thanks again.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
